title: Camera photos look blurry on a Galaxy phone
content:
Smartphone,Tablet Camera photos look blurry on a Galaxy phone: ## Troubleshooting Blurry Photos
If your pictures are coming out soft or out of focus, try the following.
### Step 1: Clean the Lens
Inspect the rear camera lens for fingerprints, dust or smudges.
Clean the lens gently with a soft, dry microfibre cloth.
### Step 2: Remove Obstructions
Remove any case or accessory that overlaps the camera housing.
### Step 3: Check Focus Settings
Open the Camera app and tap the area of the screen you want to focus on.
Avoid moving the device while the shutter is active.
### Step 4: Disable Super Steady
Open the Camera app, tap Video, and then tap the Super steady icon to turn it off.
### Step 5: Clear the Camera App Cache
Navigate to Settings.
Tap Apps.
Select Camera.
Tap Storage.
Tap Clear cache.
### Step 6: Restart the Device
Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart.
### Step 7: Request Service
If photos remain blurry, contact Samsung Support to arrange for service.
